en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-`Aziz b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Mu`adh narrated to me. He said: Sulayman b. Dawud narrated to us. He said: Al-Hakam b. Thahir narrated to us from al-Suddi from Abi Malik.
Regarding His saying, “Peace be with the Family of Yasin” [37:130], he said: Yasin is Muhammad (sw).
